key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>1%) are nasopharyngitis, diarrhea, and upper respiratory tract infection. In placebo-controlled trials nasopharyngitis occurred in 11.4% (300 mg, N=691) vs 8.6% placebo, upper respiratory tract infection 2.5% vs 0.7%. Infections were reported in 28.7% of COSENTYX subjects vs 18.9% placebo; serious infections in 0.14%.
